title: iceland-volcano-watch: open-data analysis of the Svartsengi magma accumulation (GNSS, Sentinel-1)
description: Reproducible open-data analysis of the 2023-2026 Svartsengi inflation (Reykjanes Peninsula, Iceland): station dependence of point-source magma volumes, radar 'virtual station' maps, joint GNSS and Sentinel-1 source fits (point, line of point sources, compound dislocation model port of Nikkhoo et al. 2017), with all derived tables, figures and automated tests. Retrospective only; no forecasts.
